summary: Normalise the dependent parent foreign-key name so hyphenated parent tables match their underscored typed column.
reason: ParentTable is spelled chat-attendees while the generated column is chat_attendees_id NOT NULL, so the injected key landed under a name nothing reads and every parent-scoped typed projection failed while generic rows still stored.
validated_outcome: chat_attendees_chats and chat_attendees_messages typed projections stopped failing during live sync.
